title.en: General features and loose connective tissue

body.en: Connective tissues are the most abundant and widely distributed tissues in complex animals; they link and support other tissues. In all of them except blood, the cells secrete fibres of the structural proteins collagen or elastin, and also modified polysaccharides that form the matrix or ground substance. *Loose connective tissue* has cells and fibres loosely arranged in a semi-fluid ground substance. Areolar tissue under the skin contains fibroblasts that make fibres, macrophages and mast cells. Adipose tissue, also below the skin, stores fat.
body.kn: ಸಂಯೋಜಕ ಅಂಗಾಂಶ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಹರಡಿರುವ ಅಂಗಾಂಶ; ಇತರ ಅಂಗಾಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ಜೋಡಿಸಿ ಆಧಾರ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ರಕ್ತ ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಉಳಿದವುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕೊಲಾಜನ್ ಅಥವಾ ಎಲಾಸ್ಟಿನ್ ನಾರುಗಳು. ಸಡಿಲ ಸಂಯೋಜಕ ಅಂಗಾಂಶ: ಏರಿಯೋಲಾರ್ ಮತ್ತು ಕೊಬ್ಬಿನ ಅಂಗಾಂಶ.

say.en: Areolar: fibroblasts, macrophages, mast cells.
Adipose: stores fat.
Connective tissue comes in three groups. Loose tissue: areolar and adipose.
Dense tissue: regular, as in tendons and ligaments, and irregular, as in skin.
Specialised: cartilage, bone and blood.
Tendons join muscle to bone; ligaments join bone to bone. Blood is a fluid connective tissue.
Cartilage has a pliable matrix with chondrocytes in small cavities.
Bone has a hard matrix of calcium salts; osteocytes sit in lacunae arranged in rings.

say.en: Connective tissue links and supports other tissues. Sort the examples.

body.en: In *dense connective tissue* the fibres and fibroblasts are compactly packed. In dense regular tissue the collagen fibres run in parallel rows: tendons attach skeletal muscle to bone, and ligaments attach one bone to another. In dense irregular tissue, found in the skin, fibres are oriented in different directions.
body.kn: ಸಾಂದ್ರ ಸಂಯೋಜಕ ಅಂಗಾಂಶದಲ್ಲಿ ನಾರುಗಳು ಒತ್ತಾಗಿ ಜೋಡಣೆ. ಸ್ನಾಯುರಜ್ಜು (ಟೆಂಡನ್) ಸ್ನಾಯುವನ್ನು ಮೂಳೆಗೆ, ಅಸ್ಥಿರಜ್ಜು (ಲಿಗಮೆಂಟ್) ಮೂಳೆಯನ್ನು ಮೂಳೆಗೆ ಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: Cartilage has a solid, pliable matrix that resists compression; its cells, chondrocytes, sit in small cavities. In adults it is found at the tip of the nose, the outer ear, between bones of the vertebral column, and in limbs and hands. Bone has a hard, non-pliable matrix rich in calcium salts and collagen; its cells, osteocytes, lie in spaces called lacunae. Long bones support weight and bone marrow makes blood cells. Blood is a fluid *connective tissue* of plasma, red blood cells, white blood cells and platelets.
body.kn: ಮೃದ್ವಸ್ಥಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕೊಂಡ್ರೋಸೈಟ್‌ಗಳು; ಮೂಗಿನ ತುದಿ, ಕಿವಿ. ಮೂಳೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕ್ಯಾಲ್ಸಿಯಂ ಲವಣ ಮತ್ತು ಕೊಲಾಜನ್; ಆಸ್ಟಿಯೋಸೈಟ್‌ಗಳು ಲ್ಯಾಕುನೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ. ರಕ್ತ ದ್ರವ ಸಂಯೋಜಕ ಅಂಗಾಂಶ.

myth.en: Blood is not a connective tissue because it is a liquid and has no fibres.

truth.en: Blood is a fluid connective tissue; it is the one connective tissue whose cells do not secrete collagen or elastin fibres. Connective tissues are grouped by origin and by having cells spread in a matrix, not by being solid. Plasma is blood's fluid matrix, and NCERT names blood as an exception to fibre secretion.

say.en: Four tissue types: epithelial, connective, muscular, neural.
Simple epithelium: squamous (lung air sacs), cuboidal (gland ducts, nephron), columnar (stomach, intestine), ciliated (bronchioles, fallopian tubes). Compound epithelium protects.
Tight junctions stop leakage, adhering junctions cement, gap junctions communicate.
Connective tissue: loose (areolar, adipose), dense (regular: tendon, ligament; irregular: skin), specialised (cartilage, bone, blood).

explain.en: Thin squamous cells allow diffusion; cuboidal and columnar cells with microvilli absorb; cilia move mucus or eggs; layered compound epithelium resists wear.

explain.en: Gap junctions allow rapid transfer of ions and small molecules between adjoining cells.

takeaway.en: Four tissue types: epithelial, connective, muscular, neural.

narration.en: Many people think: Blood is not a connective tissue because it is a liquid and has no fibres. Actually: Blood is a fluid connective tissue; it is the one connective tissue whose cells do not secrete collagen or elastin fibres. Connective tissues are grouped by origin and by having cells spread in a matrix, not by being solid. Plasma is blood's fluid matrix, and NCERT names blood as an exception to fibre secretion.

steps.en: Muscle to bone is joined by a tendon.
Bone to bone is joined by a ligament.
Both are dense regular connective tissue, with collagen fibres in parallel rows.

narration.en: Recap. Connective tissue links and supports; it is the most widespread tissue. Areolar and adipose are loose; tendons and ligaments are dense regular. Cartilage, bone and blood are specialised connective tissues. Blood has no fibres; it is fluid connective tissue.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಸಂಯೋಜಕ ಅಂಗಾಂಶ ಜೋಡಿಸಿ ಆಧಾರ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಏರಿಯೋಲಾರ್, ಕೊಬ್ಬು ಸಡಿಲ; ಟೆಂಡನ್, ಲಿಗಮೆಂಟ್ ಸಾಂದ್ರ ನಿಯಮಿತ. ಮೃದ್ವಸ್ಥಿ, ಮೂಳೆ, ರಕ್ತ ವಿಶೇಷ ಸಂಯೋಜಕ ಅಂಗಾಂಶಗಳು. ರಕ್ತದಲ್ಲಿ ನಾರುಗಳಿಲ್ಲ; ಅದು ದ್ರವ ಸಂಯೋಜಕ ಅಂಗಾಂಶ.

say.en: Let us recall the key ideas. Connective tissue links and supports; it is the most widespread tissue.
say.kn: ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೆನಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಣ. ಸಂಯೋಜಕ ಅಂಗಾಂಶ ಜೋಡಿಸಿ ಆಧಾರ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Areolar and adipose are loose; tendons and ligaments are dense regular.
say.kn: ಏರಿಯೋಲಾರ್, ಕೊಬ್ಬು ಸಡಿಲ; ಟೆಂಡನ್, ಲಿಗಮೆಂಟ್ ಸಾಂದ್ರ ನಿಯಮಿತ.

say.en: Cartilage, bone and blood are specialised connective tissues.
say.kn: ಮೃದ್ವಸ್ಥಿ, ಮೂಳೆ, ರಕ್ತ ವಿಶೇಷ ಸಂಯೋಜಕ ಅಂಗಾಂಶಗಳು.

say.en: Blood has no fibres; it is fluid connective tissue.
say.kn: ರಕ್ತದಲ್ಲಿ ನಾರುಗಳಿಲ್ಲ; ಅದು ದ್ರವ ಸಂಯೋಜಕ ಅಂಗಾಂಶ.
